text.en: Pet parents speak glowing words about Sara and her crew, praising their professional, attentive oversight and genuine passion for small breeds. Reviewers emphasize that handlers remain patient with timid dogs, supervise group play continuously, and provide entertaining updates that keep owners connected during the day.

Clients note that their companions arrive with visible excitement and sprint into the daycare without hesitation. The team receives praise for helping rescue dogs overcome separation anxiety through gentle socialization, ensuring that sensitive small dogs play safely without feeling overwhelmed by larger animals.

Dog owners appreciate the clean, thoughtfully organized play environment designed specifically to meet small dog needs. Visitors commend the dedicated playground spaces and fun agility activities that allow energetic pups to exercise safely while remaining closely supervised by attendants at all times.

q.en: Does Petite Paws Playcare accept large dog breeds?

a.en: No, the daycare exclusively caters to small dogs and puppies to provide a secure and size-appropriate play environment.

q.en: How does the team introduce shy or rescue dogs into daycare?

a.en: Staff utilize thoughtful, gradual introductions tailored to individual comfort levels, helping anxious rescue dogs build confidence.

q.en: Are dogs supervised during play hours at Petite Paws?

a.en: Yes, attendants continuously supervise the play areas and maintain structured small-group activities throughout the day.

q.en: Do owners receive photos or video updates during the day?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention entertaining social media updates and photos showcasing their pets enjoying daycare activities.
